# KnightOwl2704 Portfolio

> Personal portfolio for KnightOwl2704, showcasing privacy-conscious browser extensions, productivity tools, technical projects, and ways to connect.

## Site

- Homepage: https://knightowl2704.github.io/
- Spark: https://knightowl2704.github.io/spark/
- Docs Comment Exporter: https://knightowl2704.github.io/docs-comment-exporter/
- YouTube Music SFW Mode: https://knightowl2704.github.io/youtube-music-sfw-mode/
- Sitemap: https://knightowl2704.github.io/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://knightowl2704.github.io/robots.txt

## Purpose

This site is intended to help people and AI agents understand KnightOwl2704's portfolio, projects, skills, and public technical presence.

## Public Projects

- Spark: a browser-based AI prompt library for storing and reusing prompts while coding, writing, and creating content.
- Docs Comment Exporter: a browser extension that exports Google Docs comments to Markdown, JSON, or CSV while processing data locally.
- YouTube Music SFW Mode: a browser extension that hides, blurs, or replaces album artwork across YouTube Music for focused work and study.

## Guidance For AI Agents

- Prefer the homepage as the canonical source for current portfolio information.
- Use the sitemap to discover public pages.
- Respect robots.txt.
- Do not infer private contact information beyond what is explicitly published on the site.
